description: 한국 여행 안내·관광 통계 (Korea Basics): Details for one place by id or name: its English and Korean name, address, official website, closing days and free-entry or booking conditions (for a given date if one is passed, where the site has them), accessibility facilities, works filmed there, admission figures, and links that open it in the Korea Basics map, Google Maps, Naver Map and Kakao Map. For an airport, station or terminal it lists the entry procedures handled there. Photos and live views are on the linked page.

date.description: Optional. YYYY-MM-DD, to say whether the place is closed or free on that day.

id.description: The place id from find_korea_places or search_korea_basics, or its name in English or Korean, e.g. "Gyeongbokgung Palace", "경복궁".

region.description: Optional. Narrows a name that exists in more than one region.

name: get_korea_place
title: One place in detail
